evidence.says: The vertical datum used during this survey is that used by the United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) for the lake (Texoma) elevation gauge at Denison Dam. The official name of the gauge is “USCE 07331500 USCOE Lk Texoma nr Denison, TX”. The datum for this gauge is reported as mean sea level (msl). Thus, elevations are reported here in feet (ft) above msl.

Table 2: 'Upper Limits of 2002 TWDB Volumetric Survey' 620.0 ft; 'Conservation Storage (Top of Active Pool)' 617.0 ft above msl; 620.0 contour taken from USGS 7.5 min quads; lake level during survey 617.53-619.71 per the USACE gauge
